martha.name: Martha
martha.comment: Martha, swimming is looking great today, especially between 11:00 and 13:00 when the temperature will be around 30°C and the wind is calm. Not ideal for running, but who needs that when you can jump in the water? Might be a good day to surprise Britt with a swim when they get home from their shift.

britt.name: Britt
britt.comment: Britt, it's a swimming kind of day, with perfect conditions from 11:00 to 13:00 and temperatures around 26°C - maybe surprise Martha with a dip in the lake when she's free. Not ideal for running, but who needs that when the water's calling? Grab your swimsuit and make the most of it, the wind is calm and it's going to be a great afternoon.
